lines.en: label mayaspecial45:
scene rainwalkers1
This is rare.
lines.zh: 这可少见。

lines.en: Not the fact that I’m walking home with the three girls who I’d likely wind up dragging along with me to a desert island if I was forced to choose- but the fact that we’re surrounded by water.
lines.zh: 少见的不是我正和三个女孩一起走回家——如果非选不可，我很可能会把她们一起拖去某个荒岛——少见的是我们被水包围着。

lines.en: Which, I guess, is not that dissimilar from actually being stuck on a desert island. Apart from the fact that the ocean is currently crashing down around us.
lines.zh: 话说回来，这跟真的被困在荒岛上也没那么不一样。除了此刻大海正朝我们砸下来这一点。

lines.en: What I’m trying to say is that it’s raining.
lines.zh: 我想说的是：下雨了。

lines.en: I’m sorry I couldn’t put it any more eloquently — I’ve just gotten so accustomed to the fact that the rain doesn’t ever hit us that I’ve all but abandoned the idea of ever having to talk about it.
lines.zh: 抱歉我没法说得更文雅——我只是太习惯"雨从来淋不到我们"这件事，以至于我几乎已经放弃了有一天要谈论它的念头。

lines.en: That said, we’re lucky Ayane is always prepared and had not one but {i}two{/i} umbrellas stashed away in her locker for emergency scenarios like this.
lines.zh: 话虽如此，多亏 Ayane 总是有准备，她的储物柜里为了这种紧急情况藏了不止一把、而是{i}两把{/i}伞。

lines.en: If the weather reports are accurate (Which they’re normally not), this won’t be the last time either.
lines.zh: 如果天气预报准确的话（通常不准），这也不会是最后一次。

lines.en: It’s supposed to rain a lot more frequently in the coming days.
lines.zh: 接下来几天据说会下得更频繁。

lines.en: It makes sense, of course, what with our rainy season being all but devoid of actual {i}rain{/i} until now.
lines.zh: 这当然说得通，毕竟我们的雨季到现在为止几乎滴{i}雨{/i}未落。

lines.en: But life is changing.
lines.zh: 但生活在变。

lines.en: I told you that recently, didn’t I?
lines.zh: 我最近跟你说过这个，对吧？

lines.en: And with that change in life comes a change in the world because those two things are so connected at this point that one can not move without the other.
lines.zh: 而生活的变化会带来世界的变化，因为这两样东西此刻已经紧紧相连，一个不动，另一个也动不了。

lines.en: That doesn’t mean I have to like it. I honestly hate the feeling of my clothes getting wet.
lines.zh: 这不代表我非得喜欢它。我真的很讨厌衣服湿掉的感觉。

lines.en: I hate how they stick to my skin.
lines.zh: 我讨厌它们贴在皮肤上。

lines.en: But-
lines.zh: 可是——

lines.en: I hate the heat even more.
lines.zh: 我更讨厌炎热。

lines.en: And so I will accept the precipitation in place of perspiration and walk forward into puddle after puddle, drenching my shoes and socks.
lines.zh: 所以我愿意用降水代替出汗，一脚接一脚地踩进水坑，把鞋子和袜子都浸透。

lines.en: I could try to avoid them all, but there’s simply no point.
lines.zh: 我可以试着避开它们，但根本没意义。

lines.en: We can’t get off this island without getting wet.
lines.zh: 我们不弄湿自己就下不了这座岛。

lines.en: And we can’t live normal lives without a little downpour every now and then.
lines.zh: 而我们要过正常的生活，就免不了时不时来一场倾盆大雨。

lines.en: Here’s to the rainy season.
lines.zh: 敬雨季。

lines.en: And here’s to hoping it doesn’t all freeze just yet.
lines.zh: 也敬希望这一切别马上就冻上。

lines.en: : I think I really have a chance, Ayane! I’m starting to get pretty good at this whole poetry thing!
lines.zh: : 我觉得我真的有机会了，Ayane！我开始越来越擅长写诗这回事了！

lines.en: : I believe in you, Ami! I knew your educational breakthrough was only a hop, skip, and a jump away! And, despite what many workforces would have you believe, poetry totally counts as “educational!”
lines.zh: : 我相信你，Ami！我就知道你的学业突破只是几步之遥！而且，尽管许多职场会让你相信别的，诗歌绝对算得上"教育"！

lines.en: : I just hope Miss Watabe likes it. She’s a pretty harsh judge from what I hear.
lines.zh: : 我只希望 Watabe 老师会喜欢。我听说她打分挺狠的。

lines.en: : I heard from Noriko a while ago that she graded this one girl’s essay so harshly that she started bawling her eyes out and ran out of class.
lines.zh: : 我前阵子听 Noriko 说，她把某个女生的作文批得特别狠，那孩子当场哭得稀里哗啦，跑出了教室。

lines.en: : Sensei, can I ask you a question?
lines.zh: : Sensei，我能问你一个问题吗？

lines.en: : I guess. It’s not like Ami and Ayane are paying any attention to us.
lines.zh: : 问吧。反正 Ami 和 Ayane 也没在听我们说话。

lines.en: : Then, would you mind explaining to me why I’m walking under {i}your{/i} umbrella?
lines.zh: : 那，你能解释一下我为什么走在{i}你的{/i}伞下吗？

lines.en: : In as few words as possible, preferably.
lines.zh: : 最好尽量简短。

lines.en: : Because Ayane said she wanted to walk with Ami.
lines.zh: : 因为 Ayane 说她想跟 Ami 一起走。

lines.en: : I know that. I was there when she said it. What I am asking is why you agreed.
lines.zh: : 这我知道。她说的时候我就在场。我问的是你为什么答应了。

lines.en: : In a way that doesn’t make you sound like a disgusting opportunist, preferably.
lines.zh: : 最好用一种不会让你听起来像个恶心的机会主义者的说法。

lines.en: : Can we just stay silent? Not talking to you seems like the easiest option in a situation like this.
lines.zh: : 我们能干脆别说话吗？在这种情况下，不跟你说话似乎是最省事的选项。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers2
: Was my direct questioning a little too harsh?
lines.zh: : 我的直接提问是不是有点太尖锐了？

lines.en: : If you want to know why we were paired up, ask Ayane. I don’t know what to tell you.
lines.zh: : 如果你想知道我们为什么被配成一对，去问 Ayane。我不知道该跟你说什么。

lines.en: : May I at least hold the umbrella so I can walk ahead of you in complete disregard for your well-being?
lines.zh: : 那至少让我来撑伞，好让我完全不顾你的安危走在前面？

lines.en: : No. But if you want to run ahead without it, feel free.
lines.zh: : 不行。但你要想不带伞跑在前面，随便。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers3
: How unfortunate. It appears that since I can’t move ahead without running the risk of coming down with a cold, you and I are forced to stick together for the time being.
lines.zh: : 真不幸。看来既然我没法在冒着感冒的风险下抢先走，眼下你我就被迫黏在一起了。

lines.en: : Oh well. I suppose that it’s fine since there is no other option.
lines.zh: : 唉，算了。既然别无选择，那我想也无所谓。

lines.en: Is this just Maya’s weird, secret way of expressing how much she cares about me without...you know, saying {i}anything{/i} about how much she cares about me?
lines.zh: 这就是 Maya 那种奇怪的、秘密的表达方式吗——表达她有多在乎我，却……你知道的，{i}一句{/i}也不提她有多在乎我？

lines.en: Because it feels to me like she’s only asking these things right now to-
lines.zh: 因为在我看来，她现在问这些只是为了——

lines.en: : Ami, what are you looking at?
lines.zh: : Ami，你在看什么？

lines.en: Hold on. No. I was narrating. You can’t just-
lines.zh: 等等。不。我在做旁白。你不能就这么——

lines.en: : Look over there...in the middle of the road.
lines.zh: : 看那边……马路中间。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers4
Ugh, fine. Since I’m apparently not allowed to talk about my thoughts anymore, I guess I’ll-
lines.zh: 唉，行吧。既然我显然已经不被允许谈我的想法了，那我就——

lines.en: scene rainwalkers5
Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: Isn’t that-
lines.zh: : 那不是——

lines.en: : Isn’t that Kaori?
lines.zh: : 那不是 Kaori 吗？

lines.en: Can I not even get a thought out anymore?
lines.zh: 我连一个念头都说不完吗？

lines.en: : What’s Kaori doing out in the street?
lines.zh: : Kaori 在马路上干什么？

lines.en: : Better question — who is Kaori and why do we care?
lines.zh: : 更好的问题——Kaori 是谁，我们为什么要在意？

lines.en: : She works at the diner, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她在那个餐馆打工吧？

lines.en: : She works everywhere. That’s like, her whole thing. She even helped me and Uta out at the maid cafe once.
lines.zh: : 她哪儿都打工。那基本就是她的设定。她甚至还去女仆咖啡厅帮过我和 Uta。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers6
: You’re friends with her...aren’t you, Sensei? Is this normal for Kaori? Or should we, like...do something about it?
lines.zh: : 你是她的朋友……对吧，Sensei？Kaori 这样正常吗？还是说我们该……做点什么？

lines.en: : Excellent question, Ami.
lines.zh: : 问得好，Ami。

lines.en: : I have absolutely no idea.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道。

lines.en: : But, if I were to rank everyone I know on their likelihood to stand out in the middle of the street during a storm, Kaori would probably come out on top.
lines.zh: : 不过，如果让我给认识的所有人排个"暴风雨天站在马路中央的可能性"，Kaori 大概能排第一。

lines.en: : That said, we should probably still do something.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，我们大概还是该做点什么。

lines.en: : Uhh...Kaori? Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 呃……Kaori？你还好吗？

lines.en: scene rainwalkers7
: She’s clearly insane. Let’s just leave.
lines.zh: : 她明显是疯了。我们走吧。

lines.en: : Kaori? Hello? Can you hear us?
lines.zh: : Kaori？喂？听得见我们说话吗？

lines.en: : Friend?
lines.zh: : 朋友？

lines.en: scene rainwalkers8
: Waterfall?
lines.zh: : 瀑布？

lines.en: : Oh. I think that worked.
lines.zh: : 哦。我觉得这个奏效了。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers9
: Burgerfriend Friendman Burger? Innocently attractive cute maid girl who he abducted? What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 汉堡朋友·朋友人·汉堡？被他拐走的那个天真可爱的小女仆女孩？你们在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I actually like that nickname for you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我还挺喜欢她给你起的这个外号，Ami。

lines.en: : Kaori, you were just...standing in the middle of the street during a storm. What’s going on?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你刚才就……暴风雨里站在马路中央。怎么回事？

lines.en: : I was doing what?
lines.zh: : 我刚才在做什么？

lines.en: : Reverse-sitting on an asphalt car-bed while letting clear sky-fluid bounce off of your...head flesh?
lines.zh: : 反-坐在一张沥青车-床上，任由清澈的天液从你的……头部皮肉上弹开？

lines.en: scene black
: Ahh! Why did you not just say so?! Do not be so needlessly acute triangle next time!
lines.zh: : 啊！你为什么不早说？！下次别这么没必要的锐角三角形！

lines.en: : Okay, what the actual fuck is going on right now?
lines.zh: : 好吧，现在到底在搞什么鬼？

lines.en: scene rainwalkers10
: It is nice to see you again, Smaller Friend! I enjoy the yellow plastic fluid-blocker your equally-yellow companion has! It is a great thing to have on days like today! This day!
lines.zh: : 很高兴又见到你，小个子朋友！我喜欢你那位同样黄澄澄的同伴手里的黄色塑料挡液器！在像今天这样的日子里，它可真是好东西！在今天！

lines.en: : Do you...not have an umbrella, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 你……没有伞吗，Kaori？

lines.en: : Better question, when did Maya get {i}my{/i} umbrella?
lines.zh: : 更好的问题，Maya 什么时候拿走了{i}我的{/i}伞？

lines.en: : Secret.
lines.zh: : 秘密。

lines.en: : I do not possess what you refer to as the “umbrella.” I have never had a need for one until this day.
lines.zh: : 我没有你们说的那个"伞"。直到今天之前，我从来不需要它。

lines.en: : Maybe...stay inside then? You’re going to get sick if you walk around in the rain, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 那……待在屋里呢？Kaori，你在雨里走动会生病的。

lines.en: : Then all I must do is remain still! The answer is obvious!
lines.zh: : 那我只要保持不动就行了！答案很明显！

lines.en: scene rainwalkers11
: Where did you find this creature and what is wrong with it?
lines.zh: : 你从哪儿找到的这个生物，它到底有什么毛病？

lines.en: : That won’t do either, Kaori! You shouldn’t be out here in the first place.
lines.zh: : 那也不行，Kaori！你本来就不该在外面。

lines.en: : Yeah, why {i}are{/i} you out here? Shouldn’t you be at work?
lines.zh: : 是啊，你为什么{i}在外面{/i}？你不是该在上班吗？

lines.en: scene rainwalkers12
: I am! But I am not! It is hard to explain!
lines.zh: : 我在上班！可我也不在上班！这很难解释！

lines.en: : Do you remember when you helped Aunt Yukiburger and me hand out paper advertisements for the Sara? It is like that!
lines.zh: : 你还记得你帮 Yuki 汉堡阿姨和我发过 Sara 的纸质广告吗？就跟那个一样！

lines.en: : You’re handing out fliers?
lines.zh: : 你在发传单？

lines.en: : They are called birds! And no! Paper advertisements!
lines.zh: : 它们叫鸟！而且不是！是纸质广告！

lines.en: : You don’t...{i}have{/i} any paper advertisements, though.
lines.zh: : 可你……手上{i}并没有{/i}纸质广告啊。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers13
: Then I will pat myself on the backwards stomach for a work well worked and return to base!
lines.zh: : 那我就拍拍自己反向的肚子，为这干得漂亮的一"工"干得漂亮，然后返回基地！

lines.en: : And which planet is your “base” on?
lines.zh: : 你的"基地"在哪颗星球上？

lines.en: : Where are you working today, Kaori? Do you want us to walk you back? You can hang out under the waterblocker with me and Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你今天在哪儿上班，Kaori？要我们陪你走回去吗？你可以和我、还有 Ayane 一起待在挡水器底下。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers14
: That would be very helpful, Smaller Friend!
lines.zh: : 那太有帮助了，小个子朋友！

lines.en: : Today, I am working in a building full of fruit and cream! A bright building! Where creatures like you contort and mutate your face into happier versions of the same face!
lines.zh: : 今天，我在一栋装满水果和奶油的建筑里上班！一栋明亮的建筑！在那里，像你这样的生物会把脸扭曲、变异成同一张脸的更快乐版本！

lines.en: : Oh, so you do know the word “face” after all. I wish I knew that earlier.
lines.zh: : 哦，原来你还是知道"脸"这个词的。我要是早知道就好了。

lines.en: : Fruit and cream? Is it nearby?
lines.zh: : 水果和奶油？离这儿近吗？

lines.en: : The length of seven rock-throws!
lines.zh: : 七块石头那么远！

lines.en: : Seven rock-throws...I see, I see...
lines.zh: : 七块石头……我明白了，我明白了……

lines.en: : {i}Do you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真明白？{/i}

lines.en: : The only place around here that matches that description, unless Kaori has the arm strength of a professional outfielder, would be that cafe we took Ami to for her birthday a while back.
lines.zh: : 这附近唯一符合那个描述的地方，除非 Kaori 有着职业外野手级别的手臂力量，就是之前我们带 Ami 过生日去的那家咖啡厅。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers15
: What birthday was that? I don’t remember that at all.
lines.zh: : 哪次生日？我完全不记得了。

lines.en: : You don’t? Really? It should have been your-
lines.zh: : 你不记得？真的吗？那应该是你的——

lines.en: : Let us go! I will inform the manager that I did the job so she will give me another job! One with less fluids and more cream!
lines.zh: : 我们走吧！我要去告诉经理我把活干完了，她就会再给我一份活！一份液体更少、奶油更多的活！

lines.en: : Both of those jobs sound pretty good to me.
lines.zh: : 这两份工作听起来都挺不错的。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers16
: I understand your words! There are few things better than a mouth full of cream!
lines.zh: : 我听得懂你的话！没什么比满嘴奶油更好的了！

lines.en: : {i}She’s got a point there.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她说的有道理。{/i}

lines.en: Ayane doesn’t say that, but I can tell she’s thinking it.
lines.zh: Ayane 没说出口，但我看得出来她在这么想。

lines.en: : It’s not far, right? Because if it’s only seven rock-throws away, we might as well wait out the rain there. Beats having to share umbrellas at least.
lines.zh: : 不远，对吧？既然只有七块石头那么远，我们不如在那儿等雨停。至少比共用伞强。

lines.en: : Are you only saying that because you want to see Kaori with a mouth full of cream?
lines.zh: : 你这么说，只是因为想看 Kaori 满嘴奶油吧？

lines.en: : I can not cream myself until the day ends! I must wait until the customers are creamed first!
lines.zh: : 在一天结束之前我不能给自己浇奶油！我必须等客人们先被浇上奶油！

lines.en: : You heard her, Ami. You’re the one getting creamed, not Kaori. That should be fine, right?
lines.zh: : 你听见了，Ami。被浇奶油的是你，不是 Kaori。这样总该行了吧？

lines.en: scene rainwalkers17
: Getting creamed {i}does{/i} sound tempting right now. Better than just staying wet, at least.
lines.zh: : 被浇奶油现在听起来{i}确实{/i}挺诱人的。至少比一直湿着强。

lines.en: : {i}I would also like to get creamed right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我现在也想被浇奶油。{/i}

lines.en: Again, Ayane doesn’t say that. But she’s thinking it.
lines.zh: 再说一遍，Ayane 没说出口。但她在这么想。

lines.en: : Why is everyone just ignoring all of these blatant innuendos?
lines.zh: : 为什么所有人都对这些明目张胆的黄色玩笑视而不见？

lines.en: : Why are you being such a buzzkill when there is now food involved? You love food.
lines.zh: : 现在有吃的了，你为什么还这么扫兴？你明明最爱吃。

lines.en: : Because I don’t have any money and Ayane refuses to buy me anything unhealthy.
lines.zh: : 因为我没钱，而 Ayane 拒绝给我买任何不健康的东西。

lines.en: : I will not stand idly by while you destroy your adorable-
lines.zh: : 我绝不会袖手旁观你毁掉自己那可爱的——

lines.en: : Just agree and I’ll buy you whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 你答应就行，你想买什么我都给你买。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers18
: What are we waiting for? Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 那我们还等什么？走吧。

lines.en: : Okay, Kaori! Take us back to your base and cream us all!
lines.zh: : 好的，Kaori！带我们回你的基地，把我们全都浇上奶油！

lines.en: : I understand! Prepare to be creamed, small child!
lines.zh: : 我明白了！准备被浇奶油吧，小矮子！

lines.en: scene black
Kaori marches onward and the rest of us follow behind her.
lines.zh: Kaori 大步向前，我们其余人跟在她身后。

lines.en: Unfortunately though, there are no rocks around...so I am unable to discern just how much further we’ll need to walk.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，周围一块石头也没有……所以我没法判断我们到底还要走多远。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers19
Fortunately, it winds up not being very far at all and, after a few blocks, the five of us wind up escaping the rain and finding refuge in a shop that smells a little too sweet for me.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，其实根本没多远，过了几个街区，我们五个人就逃进了雨里，在一间对我来说甜得有点过头的店里找到了庇护。

lines.en: I do have a vague recollection of coming here once or twice before, but these sorts of cafes have never really had much effect on-
lines.zh: 我隐约记得以前来过一两次，不过这类咖啡厅从来没对我产生过什么——

lines.en: : Arrival!
lines.zh: : 到达！

lines.en: Okay, does no one care about my narration today?
lines.zh: 好吧，今天到底有没有人在乎我的旁白？

lines.en: : Thank you for your sudden and wet appearance inside of my humble rectangle! Please hand to me your paper advertisement for a discounted rate on the creaming!
lines.zh: : 感谢你们突然又湿漉漉地出现在我简陋的长方形里！请把你们的纸质广告交给我，好换取浇奶油的折扣价！

lines.en: : You didn’t give us any, Kaori. You were all out when we found you.
lines.zh: : 你根本没给我们，Kaori。我们找到你的时候你已经全发完了。

lines.en: : Then only the Burger-man gets a discount for being my friend! I am sorry, Smaller Friend and blue-eyed companion. Your time will come another day!
lines.zh: : 那就只有汉堡人因为是我的朋友而拿到折扣！抱歉了，小个子朋友和蓝眼睛的同伴。你们的时机在另一天！

lines.en: : That’s fine. I was going to pay for Ami anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正我本来就要给 Ami 付钱。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers20
: You were? Why? I have money. You don’t have to do that.
lines.zh: : 你会吗？为什么？我有钱。你不用这样。

lines.en: : Do you still do the couple’s discount here, Kaori? Smaller Friend and I are dating and we’d like the most private table you have.
lines.zh: : Kaori，你们这儿还有情侣折扣吗？小个子朋友和我在交往，我们想要你们最私密的桌子。

lines.en: : We do not have privacy wood for customers to eat off of, but we do support love in the form of financial benefit!
lines.zh: : 我们没有供客人进食的隐私木头，但我们确实以经济优惠的形式支持爱情！

lines.en: : Reverse-stand wherever you like and I will be with you momentarily!
lines.zh: : 想反-站在哪儿都行，我马上就来！

lines.en: : Guess that leaves-
lines.zh: : 看来只剩下——

lines.en: scene rainwalkers21
: And she sat down without me.
lines.zh: : 她就这么坐下了，没带上我。

lines.en: : Is something the matter Burger McBurger Friend McBurgerFriend McFriend Man Burger?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，汉堡·麦克汉堡·朋友·麦克汉堡朋友·麦克朋友·人·汉堡？

lines.en: : Are you sad that you will not be receiving financial benefits in the name of love? Because we have a loneliness special as well!
lines.zh: : 你是伤心于不能以爱之名获得经济优惠吗？因为我们也有孤独特惠！

lines.en: : You’d think something like that would help, but really it just makes me feel even more alone.
lines.zh: : 你会以为那种东西有点用，可实际上它只会让我觉得更孤独。

lines.en: : Well, go be alone at a rectangular wooden slab! Your large and handsome frame is blocking the doorway and will make it harder for me to cream the customers who walk in!
lines.zh: : 那就去一块长方形木板旁边孤独去吧！你那高大英俊的身躯挡住了门口，会让我更难给走进来的客人浇奶油！

lines.en: scene black
: Hah...
scene rainwalkers22
: What are you doing? Why are you sitting here? I specifically sat here so I wouldn’t have to deal with you.
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？你为什么坐这儿？我特意坐在这儿就是不想应付你。

lines.en: : Wasn’t I supposed to pay for you? That’s the only reason you came here in the first place, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 不是该我给你付钱吗？那才是你来这儿的唯一理由，不是吗？

lines.en: : I kind of hoped you would just walk across the cafe and hand me money when I got the check.
lines.zh: : 我本来还指望等我拿到账单时，你走过整个咖啡厅把钱递给我就行。

lines.en: : What’s the problem? Why can't I sit here?
lines.zh: : 有什么问题？我为什么不能坐这儿？

lines.en: : The problem is that {i}Ami{/i} is here too. And if she sees the two of us at a table together, she is going to get suspicious and it is going to make my life even more hellish than it already is.
lines.zh: : 问题是 {i}Ami{/i} 也在。要是她看见我们俩坐一张桌子，她会起疑心，然后我的日子会比现在更像地狱。

lines.en: : That’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 那不会发生的。

lines.en: : That is absolutely going to happen.
lines.zh: : 那绝对会发生。

lines.en: : No, it’s fine. Look. Ayane is distracting her.
lines.zh: : 不会，没事。你看。Ayane 正在分散她的注意力。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers23
: Are you excited to eat your cake, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你期待吃你的蛋糕吗，Ami？

lines.en: : I am! It looks super delicious! Thank you so much, Ayane!
lines.zh: : 期待！它看起来超级好吃！谢谢你，Ayane！

lines.en: : Great, great.
lines.zh: : 很好，很好。

lines.en: : Now, tell me, what are your thoughts on the apocalypse?
lines.zh: : 那么告诉我，你对世界末日有什么看法？

lines.en: scene rainwalkers24
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene rainwalkers25
: I really hope they’re not talking about what I think they’re talking about...
lines.zh: : 我真希望她们不是在聊我以为她们在聊的那个话题……

lines.en: : They’re almost certainly talking about what you think they’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 她们几乎肯定就是在聊你以为她们在聊的那个话题。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers26
: Hah...she’s going to ruin everything, Sensei. I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 哈……她会把一切都毁了的，Sensei。我感觉得到。

lines.en: : You’ve felt a lot of things and only a few of them have wound up being true.
lines.zh: : 你感觉到过很多事，其中只有几件最后成真了。

lines.en: : {i}No...{/i}A few of them have wound up being {i}wrong.{/i} Need I remind you that nearly all of my predictions up until recently had been spot-on?
lines.zh: : {i}不{/i}……只有几件最后是{i}错的{/i}。需要我提醒你吗，直到不久之前，我几乎所有的预言都是精准无误的？

lines.en: : Or is that just what you were programmed to think?
lines.zh: : 还是说，那只是你被设定成这么想的？

lines.en: scene rainwalkers27
: You know, I really...{i}really{/i} wish Tsuneyo never mentioned something like that. Because you might be joking now, but that has stuck with me and I can’t get it out of my head.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我真的……{i}真的{/i}希望 Tsuneyo 从没提过那种事。因为你现在也许是在开玩笑，但那句话一直卡在我脑子里，怎么也甩不掉。

lines.en: : Just think about that time we almost kissed instead. I’m sure that’ll overwrite it.
lines.zh: : 那就想想我们差点接吻那次吧。我肯定那会把它覆盖掉。

lines.en: : Yeah, with more earth-shattering loneliness and an even greater desire to brutally and violently make up for lost time in your bedroom.
lines.zh: : 是啊，换来的是更具毁灭性的孤独，以及更强烈的、想要在你卧室里粗暴而猛烈地补回失去时光的欲望。

lines.en: : You know, I’ve waited a long time to hear you say things like that, but now that you {i}do{/i} say things like that, it’s just weird.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我等了很久想听你说这种话，可你{i}真{/i}说出口了，又只觉得奇怪。

lines.en: : You did this to yourself. If you’re going to make me suffer every single day of my life, the least I can do is make you suffer as well.
lines.zh: : 这是你自找的。既然你要让我人生中的每一天都受苦，那我至少也能让你一起受苦。

lines.en: : Well, it’s working. So...keep at it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，有效。所以……大概就继续吧。

lines.en: : Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya？

lines.en: scene rainwalkers28
: God, I fucking hate this.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我他妈的恨死这个了。

lines.en: : Hello, Friend! I regret to inform you that there is no hot meat! But there is plenty of-
lines.zh: : 你好，朋友！我很遗憾地通知你，没有热肉！但是有很多——

lines.en: : Cream. Yes, Kaori. I know.
lines.zh: : 奶油。对，Kaori。我知道。

lines.en: : How would you like to be creamed?
lines.zh: : 你想怎么被浇奶油？

lines.en: : Brutally and violently in my bedroom by a girl who likes watermelons a little too much.
lines.zh: : 在我卧室里，被一个喜欢西瓜喜欢得有点过头的女孩，粗暴而猛烈地浇。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers29
: Die.
lines.zh: : 去死。

lines.en: : Your words apart from “watermelon” do not register in my brain-space, but I will explain your characteristics to the manager and have them guess what you would like to consume based on that!
lines.zh: : 除了"西瓜"之外的词都进不了我的脑空间，不过我会把你的特征讲给经理听，让她据此猜你想吃点什么！

lines.en: : Is there anything else you require?
lines.zh: : 你还需要别的什么吗？

lines.en: : Not for me. Thanks, though.
lines.zh: : 我就不用了。不过谢谢。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers30
: I understand! Please be patient for others must be creamed first!
lines.zh: : 我明白了！请耐心等待，因为必须先给其他人浇上奶油！

lines.en: : Is there a menu I could-
lines.zh: : 有没有菜单我可以——

lines.en: scene rainwalkers31
: ...look at?
scene rainwalkers32
: What just happened?
lines.zh: : 刚才发生了什么？

lines.en: : It looks like you were ignored.
lines.zh: : 看来你被无视了。

lines.en: : But...I’ve never been ignored in my life. I’m adorable. Can you see me? You can see how adorable I am, right?
lines.zh: : 可……我这辈子从来没被无视过。我很可爱啊。你能看见我吧？你能看出我有多可爱，对吧？

lines.en: : I can see how humble you are.
lines.zh: : 我能看出你有多谦虚。

lines.en: : What do I do now?
lines.zh: : 那我现在该怎么办？

lines.en: : Starve, I guess.
lines.zh: : 饿着呗，我猜。

lines.en: : Call her back over. She’s {i}your{/i} friend, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 把她叫回来。她不是{i}你{/i}朋友吗？

lines.en: : Ugh...fine.
lines.zh: : 唉……好吧。

lines.en: : Kaori.
lines.zh: : Kaori。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers33
: Eleven!
lines.zh: : 十一！

lines.en: : That’s...nice. Aren’t you forgetting something, though?
lines.zh: : 那……挺好。不过你是不是忘了点什么？

lines.en: scene rainwalkers34
: The Queen of Spiders does not forget. She knows the answers to all things even before she asks.
lines.zh: : 蜘蛛女王不会遗忘。她甚至在开口之前就知道一切的答案。

lines.en: : Then...why did you ask?...
lines.zh: : 那……你为什么还要问？……

lines.en: : I need a menu. Either that or a...recommendation or-
lines.zh: : 我需要一份菜单。或者一个……推荐，或者——

lines.en: : Friend, as much as I enjoy the feeling of my vision balls connecting with yours, I have customers to cream. So if you do not have something to ask for-
lines.zh: : 朋友，虽然我很享受我的眼球和你的眼球相触的感觉，但我还有客人要浇奶油。所以如果你没有要点的东西——

lines.en: : A...menu would be fine, Kaori. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 一……一份菜单就行，Kaori。谢谢。

lines.en: scene rainwalkers35
: Shiny, plastic-coated list of sustenance, coming right up! Prepare for another rectangle!
lines.zh: : 闪闪发亮、覆着塑料的营养清单，马上就来！准备迎接又一个长方形！

lines.en: : Wha-
scene rainwalkers36
: I fucking hate your weird friend.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的恨你那个古怪的朋友。

lines.en: : Maybe you just have to speak her language.
lines.zh: : 也许你只要说她的语言就行了。

lines.en: : And make myself sound like a complete idiot? No thanks. You’ll order for me. And I’ll be having one of everything on the menu. I hope you’re happy.
lines.zh: : 然后让自己听起来像个彻底的傻子？谢了，不必。你替我点。菜单上的每一样我都要一份。我希望你满意。

lines.en: : As long as you’re happy-
lines.zh: : 只要你开心——

lines.en: : Don’t hit on me when I’m angry. Or hungry. Or ever.
lines.zh: : 别在我生气的时候撩我。或者饿的时候。或者任何时候。

lines.en: : What? What’s that stupid fucking face for? What are you thinking?
lines.zh: : 什么？你那张蠢脸怎么回事？你在想什么？

lines.en: : I’m just wondering if hate sex would count toward potentially deleting me.
lines.zh: : 我只是在想，仇恨性爱算不算会导致我被删掉。

lines.en: : It would.
: But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Trust me.
lines.zh: : 相信我。

lines.en: : It would.
scene black
: I guess I’ll just take your word for it...
lines.zh: : 我想我就信你的话吧……

lines.en: In the end, Maya never gets to communicate with our waitress.
lines.zh: 最后，Maya 始终没能和我们的服务员说上话。

lines.en: But, to be fair, I think she’d have failed if she’d gotten a chance anyway.
lines.zh: 不过说句公道话，我觉得就算她有机会，也一样会失败。

lines.en: Kaori isn’t exactly the easiest person to talk to, but...that’s kicked up a few notches when she won’t even acknowledge you.
lines.zh: Kaori 本来就不是个好说话的人，何况……当她连理都不理你的时候，难度又上了一个台阶。

lines.en: Thankfully (For Maya, not my wallet), {i}I’m{/i} able to order on behalf of the bottomless pit and we all proceed to {b}HAVE A NORMAL, FUN MEAL BEFORE RETURNING HOME.{/b}
lines.zh: 幸好（对 Maya 来说幸好，对我的钱包来说不是），{i}我{/i}能替那个无底洞点单，然后我们大家就地{b}进行了一顿正常又开心的饭，之后便回家了{/b}。
